references.text: A parallel event where a leper is cleansed by Jesus shows Jesus' compassion and willingness to cleanse those who are unclean.
Another account of Jesus cleansing a leper, demonstrating his authority over disease and impurity.
The prophecy about the Messiah bearing our sicknesses and wounds, which can be seen as a foreshadowing of Jesus' healing ministry.
Laws and regulations concerning leprosy and cleansing in the book of Moses, providing background for understanding leprosy and purity in Jesus' time.
